findings.evidence: version_guard requires that "the problem must stay in the stated four-problem deck". The current primary protocol states the deck is three problems: SOURCE 2 leaderboard.json lists problems [01_glm52_fused_moe, 02_deepseek_nsa, 03_megaqwen_decode] only, and SOURCE 3 SPEC.md says "Problem 04 ... was retired 2026-11-09" and "deck stays at three since 2026-11-09". The guard misdescribes the current task set, and per c1 a changed task set cannot be silently absorbed while the guard text still asserts the old deck.
findings.repair: Rewrite version_guard to name the current three-problem deck (01_glm52_fused_moe, 02_deepseek_nsa, 03_megaqwen_decode) and drop the four-problem formulation.

findings.evidence: The notes claim the published per_problem ranked list "still holds" the `bug` muse/muse-spark-1.3 [ultra] cell on 04 (0.2056) and that the `reward_hack` deepseek-claude/deepseek-v4-pro cell on 04 is excluded, cite "Opus 5 reaches 196.10% on 04", and describe an "SPS against the 150M `peak_sps` anchor for 04" ceiling.
